title: Ze’ira bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was the host of Rabbi Ami, Rabbi Assi, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi and all the Rabbis of Caesarea, and he said to Rav Yosef, son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, “Son of a lion, come, I will tell you a fine thing your father used to do”: Yoma 78a. In Jerusalem Talmud Yoma, beginning of chapter 8: Rabbi Ze’ira bar Chama, Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6 the statement reads “Ze’irah bar Chama, Yosah son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” and Hyman considers the words “of Rabbi Chanina in the name of” missing.
In Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 3:8, Rabbi Lazar said to Rabbi Ze’ira bar Chama.

notes.text: The supplied Yoma 78a locator remains. The son-of-Yehoshua-ben-Levi versus son-of-Chanina/in-the-name-of reconstruction is Hyman’s proposal, not an established corrected chain. The Taanit and Beitzah chapter/halakhah citations are Jerusalem Talmud.

Davidson Yoma 78a directly names Ze’ira bar Chama as host and his address to Rav Yosef son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. This does not decide Hyman’s reconstruction of the distinct Jerusalem Talmud Yoma/Taanit transmission chains.
